reading_2.theme: tRNA charging, modification and translational fidelity
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation together with tRNA modification and splicing, framed as maintenance of accurate decoding, alongside other translational fidelity mechanisms like selenocysteine incorporation and diphthamide.

reading_1.theme: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response

reading_2.theme: Integrated stress response and unfolded protein response
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are eIF2alpha-kinase translational control (PERK, HRI, GCN2) and IRE1/PERK UPR branches, framed as cellular stress signalling that decides between adaptation and apoptosis, including beta-cell death.

reading_1.theme: Craniofacial and limb skeletal morphogenesis

reading_2.theme: Craniofacial and limb embryonic morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Cellular responses to heavy metals and oxidative stress
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe MTF1-driven metallothionein binding and cellular responses to zinc, copper, iron, manganese, cobalt, lead, mercury and selenium, framed as metal detoxification that protects against metal-induced oxidative and redox stress (with HMOX1 induction).

reading_2.theme: Cellular responses to heavy metals and metal detoxification
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are MTF1/metallothionein-mediated responses to diverse metal ions, framed as metal stress handling and detoxification, of which cadmium transport and detoxification is a specific case.

reading_2.theme: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the urea cycle enzymes, arginine/citrulline/ornithine interconversion and their inherited deficiencies (OTC, NAGS, HHH), framed as hepatic ammonia detoxification, supported by the ornithine and cationic amino acid transport in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Ionotropic and G protein-mediated synaptic transmission
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe kainate and AMPA receptor activation, GIRK channels and Gbeta-gamma inhibition of calcium channels, framed as fast and modulatory neurotransmitter receptor signalling alongside nicotinic acetylcholine receptors.

reading_2.theme: cAMP second-messenger signalling via adenylate cyclase and PKA
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are cAMP production and PKA activation downstream of GPCRs, framed as the cyclic-nucleotide signalling cascade that leads to CREB phosphorylation and neuronal and dopaminergic responses.

reading_2.theme: Bacterial lipid sensing by TLR2/TLR4 in monocytes

reading_2.theme: Type 2 immunity: Th2, IL-33 and eosinophils
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are IL-33 alarmin signalling and Th2 differentiation driving IL-4/5/13 and mast cell activation against helminths, framed as the type 2 inducer arm whose effector output includes eosinophil recruitment and activation.

reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are viral genome translation and replication (frameshifting, replicase maturation, capping) and SARS-CoV modulation of host translation, framed as viral replication strategies within general viral mRNA synthesis, translation and PKR evasion.

shared: negative regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication
regulation of DNA-templated DNA replication initiation

reading_1.theme: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication initiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe E2F target transcription at G1/S and the initiation and regulation of mitotic DNA replication, framed as the proliferation programme that drives cell-cycle progression into S phase and on toward G2/M.

reading_2.theme: E2F-driven G1/S transcription and DNA replication licensing
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the E2F transcriptional program and G1/S genes that drive replication initiation, framed as the transcriptional control of origin licensing and pre-replicative complex assembly and activation.

positive regulation of actin filament depolymerization
regulation of barbed-end actin filament capping

reading_1.theme: Actin filament severing, capping and network remodeling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are actin turnover regulators (severing, barbed-end capping, crosslinking, Arp2/3 inhibition, caspase cleavage of cytoskeleton), framed as cytoskeletal remodeling that powers motility and ruffle formation.

reading_2.theme: Actin filament dynamics in cell motility
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are actin network assembly, crosslinking, capping and severing, framed as the cytoskeletal machinery driving lamellipodial cell migration.

reading_1.theme: Metanephric nephron induction and differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud elongation, metanephric mesenchyme differentiation and nephron patterning, framed as the mesenchymal-to-epithelial program that turns nephron progenitors into tubules.

reading_2.theme: Kidney development and nephron formation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are early kidney induction (intermediate mesoderm, ureteric bud, metanephric mesenchyme differentiation, renal vesicle), framed as the start of nephron segment morphogenesis.

reading_1.theme: LDL receptor-mediated cholesterol uptake and its regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are LDL/VLDL receptor endocytosis, lysosomal degradation of the receptor and LXR-driven limitation of cholesterol uptake, framed as cellular sterol homeostasis by controlling cholesterol import.

reading_2.theme: LDL receptor turnover and cholesterol uptake
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe downregulation of LDL/VLDL receptors via lysosomal degradation and reduced recycling to limit cholesterol import, framed as receptor trafficking to the lysosome.

reading_1.theme: Bone formation and RUNX2-driven osteoblast differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are skeletal tissue formation (ossification, osteoblast development, cartilage, tendon, sutures), framed as the RUNX2-directed osteoblast programme.

reading_2.theme: Skeletal development: bone, cartilage, tendon and joints
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe osteoblast development, intramembranous ossification, trabecular bone, cartilage and tendon formation, framed as the tissue-building programme of skeletal morphogenesis that includes forming the joints between skeletal elements.

regulation of L-glutamate import across plasma membrane

reading_1.theme: Excitatory amino acid transport
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe glutamate/aspartate uptake by SLC1 transporters, glutamate homeostasis and their disease defects, framed as amino acid transport that also covers serine and glutamine.

reading_2.theme: Glutamate and GABA neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are excitatory amino acid transporter-mediated glutamate/aspartate uptake and its disease variants, framed as neurotransmitter clearance and recycling alongside GABA synthesis, reuptake and vesicular loading.

shared: collagen-activated tyrosine kinase receptor signaling pathway

reading_1.theme: Basement membrane and collagen extracellular matrix assembly
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are about cell-matrix adhesion and basement membrane architecture (laminin, integrins, hemidesmosomes, anchoring fibrils), framed as anchoring tissue to a collagen and elastic fibre matrix.

reading_2.theme: Basement membrane assembly and integrin-mediated cell-matrix adhesion
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are structural cell-ECM anchoring (integrin, laminin and collagen interactions building basement membranes, hemidesmosomes and anchoring fibrils), the scaffold that dystroglycan complexes and neuromuscular junction organisation also build upon.

shared: regulation of angiotensin levels in blood
regulation of blood volume by renin-angiotensin

reading_1.theme: Renin-angiotensin system and blood pressure/volume regulation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are the renin-angiotensin-kinin peptide system (angiotensin generation and signalling, bradykinin breakdown) acting on renal sodium and water excretion, framed as body-fluid and blood pressure homeostasis.

reading_2.theme: Renin-angiotensin control of blood pressure and volume
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are angiotensin generation and signalling plus peptide catabolism (bradykinin, neuropeptides) regulating renal sodium excretion, urine and blood volume, framed as the renin-angiotensin regulation of systemic arterial pressure.

positive regulation of epithelial cell proliferation involved in wound healing

reading_1.theme: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and skin barrier formation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways regulate the balance of keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and death in the epidermis, framed as the upstream control leading to cornification and skin barrier formation.

reading_2.theme: Epidermal keratinocyte differentiation and skin appendage development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis, epidermal stem cell control, sebaceous gland and melanocyte development and wound re-epithelialization, framed as skin homeostasis that also includes hair follicle cycling and nail formation.

reading_1.theme: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are biosynthesis of resolvins, protectins, maresins and lipoxins from omega-3 fatty acids and arachidonate, framed as lipid-mediated resolution of inflammation, with eicosanoid and leukotriene inactivation by omega-oxidation in the additional pathways.

reading_2.theme: Lipoxygenase-derived lipid mediators and inflammation resolution
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the biosynthesis of specialized pro-resolving mediators (lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins) as the resolution arm of lipoxygenase oxylipin metabolism, which also produces hepoxilins and 12-HETE derivatives.

shared: regulation of retrograde transport, endosome to Golgi

reading_1.theme: Golgi-endosome-lysosome protein sorting and retrograde trafficking
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, lysosomal protein targeting and endosome-to-Golgi retrograde retrieval, framed as the post-Golgi membrane sorting system for lysosome biogenesis and the secretory pathway.

reading_2.theme: Endosome-Golgi retrograde and lysosomal trafficking
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are endosome-to-TGN retrograde transport and Golgi-to-lysosome sorting, framed as vesicular cargo sorting that maintains organelle identity and lysosomal hydrolase delivery.

shared: response to granulocyte macrophage colony-stimulating factor

[untitled BTM module] Granulocyte development and activation is the theme here: a transcriptional core that commits myeloid progenitors to the neutrophil lineage, a cytokine receptor that drives their expansion, and signalling and cytoskeletal components that let mature cells respond. PU.1 and the retinoic acid receptor set and maintain myeloid identity, which is why blockade of retinoid signalling in promyelocytic leukaemia arrests cells short of maturity and why pharmacological retinoid treatment restores it.

reading_1.theme: Myeloid progenitor commitment and granulocyte differentiation
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe the transcriptional and cytokine (PU.1, RAR, GM-CSF/CSF receptor) programme that commits myeloid progenitors to granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell fates, read here as the lineage-resolution step at the promyelocyte stage where erythroid potential is suppressed.

reading_2.theme: Myeloid progenitor commitment and granulopoiesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are transcriptional and cytokine (GM-CSF, RA, CSF) programs committing myeloid progenitors to granulocyte and mast cell lineages, framed as granulopoiesis driven further by G-CSF and RUNX1.

reading_1.theme: Actin-driven membrane protrusion and cell migration
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways cover actin polymerization, severing, capping and Arp2/3 regulation driving lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and macropinocytosis, framed as leading-edge cytoskeletal dynamics powering cell motility and chemotaxis.

reading_2.theme: Actin-driven lamellipodial cell migration
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are actin polymerization, severing and capping that build lamellipodia, ruffles, podosomes and pseudopodia, framed as leading-edge protrusion for cell migration downstream of Rho GTPase-WAVE-Arp2/3.

left ventricular cardiac muscle tissue morphogenesis

reading_1.theme: Cardiac muscle development and heart morphogenesis
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are ventricular/atrial myocardium growth, trabeculation, compaction and septation, framed as heart chamber morphogenesis.

reading_2.theme: Cardiac chamber morphogenesis and myocardial development
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe ventricular and atrial myocardium growth, trabeculation, compaction and septation, framed as the muscular part of heart chamber formation alongside endocardial, septal and coronary vascular development.

shared: positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction
Signalling to p38 via RIT and RIN

reading_1.theme: Neurotrophin Trk receptor signalling
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are NGF-TRKA activation and its downstream RAS/MAPK, ERK5, PI3K/AKT, PLC-gamma and CREB cascades, framed as the neurotrophin signalling program for neuronal survival and maturation shared with NTF3-NTRK3.

reading_2.theme: NGF/TRKA neurotrophin signalling and p75NTR survival-death control
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are the TRKA receptor tyrosine kinase arm of NGF signalling (RAS/MAPK, ERK5, p38, PI3K/AKT, PLC-gamma, CREB) driving neuronal survival, differentiation and transcription, set against the p75NTR/proNGF death-and-survival signalling of the additional set.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis of UDP-sugars and CMP-sialic acid and their SLC35 transport into the Golgi, framed as donor supply for glycosylation (with CDG disorders) consumed by GPI-anchor and glycosphingolipid biosynthesis.

reading_2.theme: Nucleotide-sugar synthesis and transport for glycosylation
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis of UDP-GlcNAc, CMP-sialic acid and other activated sugars and their SLC35 transport into the Golgi, with the congenital disorders caused by their defects, framed as the substrate supply for glycan assembly.

reading_1.theme: Hepatic glucose production and fructose metabolism
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe gluconeogenesis, G6P transport/hydrolysis, glucokinase regulation and fructose catabolism with their disorders, framed as liver glucose output balanced against glycogen turnover.

reading_2.theme: Hepatic glucose, fructose and glycerol metabolism
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe gluconeogenesis, glucokinase regulation, glucose-6-phosphatase/transporter function and fructose catabolism with their inherited disorders, framed as liver hexose phosphate metabolism feeding into glycerol and polyol metabolism.

reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe DSB sensing, ATM signaling, BRCA1/BRCA2 function and pathway choice between NHEJ, alt-NHEJ and homologous recombination, framed as the core of double-strand break repair extended by strand invasion, SDSA and crosslink repair.

reading_2.theme: DNA double-strand break repair: NHEJ and homologous recombination
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways are DSB sensing and ATM/BRCA1/BRCA2 signalling plus the end-joining routes, framed as the damage response and repair-pathway choice upstream of the homologous recombination mechanics (resection, strand exchange, D-loop resolution, SSA).

reading_1.theme: Mitotic chromosome segregation: cohesion, spindle and checkpoint
reading_1.core_role: The shared pathways describe sister chromatid cohesion and its resolution, PLK1/Aurora/NEK kinase signalling, spindle formation and spindle checkpoint control, framed as the machinery of mitotic chromosome segregation including establishment of cohesion and G2/M entry.

reading_2.theme: Mitotic chromosome segregation, spindle checkpoint and cytokinesis
reading_2.core_role: The shared pathways describe sister chromatid cohesion and separation, spindle assembly checkpoint and PLK1/Aurora/NEK kinase control, framed as the chromosome segregation step that precedes spindle elongation and cytokinetic ring division.
